source: Nnn… *stretches*
translation: 嗯……*伸懒腰*

source: Oh hey, you’re up, Yoshi!
translation: 哦，嘿，你起床了，Yoshi！

source: Good morning, Yoshinori.
translation: 早上好，Yoshinori。

source: Good morning too, guys!
translation: 你们也早上好，各位！

source: Haha, looks like everyone really does get up earlier than me.
translation: 哈哈，看来大家确实都比我起得早。

source: Well, we all wanna give that inspector a better impression today, like Gramps said last night.
translation: 这个嘛，就像Gramps昨晚说的，今天大家都想给检查员留下更好的印象。

source: That, and I made everyone some hot cocoa and coffee~!
translation: 而且我还给大家准备了热可可和咖啡～！

source: *sip* Mmm…
translation: *啜饮* 嗯……

source: Jin here was up all night!
translation: Jin 昨晚通宵没睡！

source: As usual.
translation: 一如既往。

source: Emilia sent me an angry email last night with tons of work, so I kinda wanted to get that over with.
translation: Emilia昨晚给我发了一封怒气冲冲的邮件，附带大量工作，所以我想赶快做完。

source: Oh, I hope it wasn’t too difficult.
translation: 哦，希望不会太困难。

source: Not really. It’s database work, so it’s more on the tedious side.
translation: 倒也不会。只是数据库工作，所以更多是烦琐。

source: Sounds complicated to me. Shouldn’t you get some rest, buddy?
translation: 听起来很复杂。你不该休息一下吗，伙计？

source: I’m already done for the day, actually! Now I can hang out with you guys before I go to bed!
translation: 其实我今天的工作已经结束了！现在睡觉前可以和你们待一会儿！

source: Yes, come relax with us while we finish our breakfast. We’re way too early for today’s schedule, anyway.
translation: 是啊，来和我们一起放松，等大家吃完早餐。反正距离今天的日程还早得很。

source: It looks like you’re doing something fun, though! Are you guys playing cards?
translation: 不过你们好像在做很有趣的事！是在玩牌吗？

source: Oh, these aren’t playing cards, they’re tarot cards! I’m trying to foresee what Sir Goro has in store for his future!
translation: 哦，这不是扑克牌，是塔罗牌！我正试着预见Goro先生的未来！

source: You... You can tell the future?
translation: 你……你能预知未来？

source: Not just that! You see, tarot cards are used to gain insight into the past, present or future by formulating a question, then drawing and interpreting the cards~!
translation: 不只如此！塔罗牌会先提出问题，再抽取和解读牌面，从而洞察过去、现在或未来～！

source: It’s up to the individual as to what they do with the knowledge seen on their path.
translation: 至于如何运用道路上看到的知识，就取决于每个人自己。

source: Oh… that’s interesting. So that’s what you were talking about last night, too.
translation: 哦……真有意思。所以你昨晚说的也是这个。

source: Yup!
translation: 没错！

source: Lloyd did mine a while ago and it was mostly accurate.
translation: Lloyd前不久替我占卜过，大部分都很准。

source: I don’t usually believe in things like these but… I must say, this is some lighthearted entertainment.
translation: 我通常不相信这种东西，不过……不得不说，这算是轻松有趣的消遣。

source: *ehem* It’s a closely related sub-branch of astrology!
translation: *咳咳* 这是与占星术密切相关的一个分支！

source: I’m curious. What did Aiden’s reading say, Lloyd?
translation: 我很好奇。Aiden的牌面怎么说，Lloyd？

source: Well, after I drew the ‘Sun, ‘World’, and ‘Fool’, we determined that they all encompass his persona and general approach to life!
translation: 这个嘛，抽到“太阳”“世界”和“愚人”后，我们判断这些牌涵盖了他的性格和总体人生态度！

source: Did he just call Aiden a… fool?
translation: 他刚才是把Aiden叫作……愚人吗？

source: N-No! Don’t misunderstand - these cards mean good things like free spirit, fullfilment and harmony!
translation: 不、不是！别误会——这些牌代表自由精神、圆满与和谐之类的好事！

source: The sun references happiness, warmth and vitality, and when combined with the Fool emphasizes innocence and optimism!
translation: 太阳象征幸福、温暖和活力，与愚人结合时则强调纯真与乐观！

source: When further combined with the World, it may reflect a lack of power over events, but with patience, a new opportunity can be expected!
translation: 再结合世界牌，或许反映出对事件缺乏掌控，但只要耐心等待，就能迎来新的机会！

source: Pains and struggles from the past are balanced out with boundless growth and inner strength…
translation: 过去的痛苦与挣扎，会由无限的成长和内在力量来平衡……

source: So, face your choices firmly to achieve your ideal happiness, or else it could lead to your ultimate regret!
translation: 所以要坚定面对自己的选择，才能实现理想的幸福，否则可能留下终生遗憾！

source: T-That sounds really ominous… Is Aiden going to be alright?
translation: 听、听起来真不祥……Aiden会没事吗？

source: Naaaah~ I don’t really take it too seriously! Especially not from a leprechaun.
translation: 不会啦～我没真的把它当回事！尤其这种话还是小矮妖说的。

source: L-Leprechaun?! You could’ve at least called me a wizard!
translation: 小、小矮妖？！你至少也可以叫我巫师！

source: Either way, that’s a good mindset for the whole thing, Aiden.
translation: 不管怎样，这种心态很适合面对整件事，Aiden。

source: Lloyd kept foretelling the ‘Death’ one for me, too. But I’m still alive.
translation: Lloyd也一直替我预言出“死神”牌。但我还活着。

source: Hey! You never know! Maybe not for long!
translation: 喂！这可说不准！也许活不了多久！

source: Oh, Yuri, dear. What brings you he—
translation: 哦，亲爱的Yuri。什么风把你吹来——

source: Emilia wants everyone in the campsite. Now.
translation: Emilia要所有人去营地。现在。

source: It’s not call time for thirty more minutes. What’s going on?
translation: 距离集合时间还有三十分钟。发生什么了？

source: I don’t know, but she’s already gathered all the workers. You guys should just go and see for yourselves.
translation: 我不知道，但她已经召集了所有工人。你们自己过去看看吧。

source: Sheesh… Sounds like someone woke up on the wrong side of the bed today, huh…?
translation: 天啊……听起来有人今天一早心情就很糟，对吧……？

source: *sigh* I wonder what Emilia did to get on her nerves so early in the morning…
translation: *叹气* 不知道Emilia一大早做了什么，把她惹成这样……

source: I’d expected her to spazz over how a bunch of guys slept together!
translation: 我还以为她会因为一群男人睡在一起而大发雷霆！

source: I guess knowing her, it is odd.
translation: 以她的性格来说，确实奇怪。

source: Either way, we shouldn’t keep the inspector waiting. Come on, let’s get ready and head over.
translation: 不管怎样，不能让检查员等。来吧，准备好就过去。

source: Right.
translation: 好。

source: Tsk, tsk. Late, just like I expected…
translation: 啧，啧。果然和我预料的一样迟到……

source: This meeting isn’t even on the schedule.
translation: 这场会议根本不在日程上。

source: Scheduled or not, the management staff being the last ones to arrive is very telling.
translation: 无论是否安排在日程中，管理人员最后才到已经很说明问题。

source: Whatever happened to this camp’s oath about being prepared for anything?
translation: 这座营地那条随时做好准备的誓言去哪了？

source: I thought so.
translation: 果然如此。

source: Well, we’re here now. What do you want?
translation: 好了，我们现在到了。你想做什么？

source: Ladies, please. Let’s just get to business.
translation: 两位女士，拜托。我们还是谈正事吧。

source: Of course! I’ve gathered you all here today to make a very IMPORTANT announcement regarding our productivity for the next few months.
translation: 当然！我今天召集各位，是要宣布一项有关未来几个月工作效率的非常重要的事项。

source: After my inspection and a meticulous review of everyone’s progress so far – I have worked overnight to create a detailed timetable for the next few months.
translation: 经过检查并仔细审查每个人目前的进度后——我通宵制定了一份未来几个月的详细时间表。

source: This new schedule includes every deadline for each aspect of the project!
translation: 这份新日程列出了项目各方面的每一个截止日期！

source: Do note that these due dates are GENEROUSLY calculated, so I’m expecting nothing less than for everyone to STRICTLY follow the schedule.
translation: 请注意，这些期限已经计算得非常宽裕，所以我要求所有人严格遵守日程，不能有任何折扣。

source: Here are the instructions for each department head.
translation: 这是给各部门负责人的说明。

source: These folders contain each department’s tasks, concerns, and a reminder of how everything should be done. Make sure to read and follow the details carefully.
translation: 这些文件夹包含各部门的任务、问题，以及各项工作应如何完成的提示。务必仔细阅读并遵循所有细节。

source: Everything you need to know is in there, so I don’t want to hear any questions later.
translation: 需要知道的一切都在里面，所以之后我不想听到任何问题。

source: Mr. Clermont has invested a LOT into this venture, so I’m sure we can all agree to show him nothing but the best.
translation: Clermont先生为这项事业投入了巨资，相信大家都同意只能向他呈现最好的成果。

source: No hard feelings, it’s just business after all.
translation: 别往心里去，毕竟只是公事。

source: Take special note with yours, I’ve added extra details addressing my concerns from yesterday.
translation: 你的那份要特别注意，我针对昨天的担忧添加了额外细节。

source: Whoa… I get a stack...?
translation: 哇……我拿到一整叠……？

source: I’m just as surprised, as I thought maintenance was fairly self-explanatory, but clearly you needed more guidance to do such a simple job.
translation: 我也同样惊讶。我以为维护工作不言自明，但显然这么简单的工作，你也需要更多指导。

source: I’m sure if we all approach this with a positive attitude, we’ll achieve our collective goal. That’s what we all want, isn’t it?
translation: 我相信只要大家以积极态度面对，就能实现共同目标。这正是我们所有人想要的，不是吗？

source: Now, for all the workers, grab a copy of the schedule here.
translation: 现在，所有工人到这里领取一份日程。

source: Forgive me for interrupting, Ms. Komarova, but…
translation: 请原谅我打断一下，Komarova女士，不过……

source: I’ve noticed that this schedule is similar to our previous one but now includes extensive work over the winter season.
translation: 我注意到这份日程与之前类似，但现在加入了大量冬季工作。

source: Yes, it has come to my attention that the original timetable included a large unproductive break of several weeks.
translation: 是的，我注意到原时间表中包含一段长达数周、毫无产出的休息期。

source: I think it would be a waste of time to stop, especially since we’ll have already built up our momentum by then.
translation: 我认为停工会浪费时间，尤其届时我们已经建立起工作势头。

source: If I may, the weather can get quite harsh during the winter around these parts…
translation: 容我说明，这一带冬季的天气会非常恶劣……

source: It could potentially be a hazardous environment for our workers, and there would be additional costs for the necessary equipment to work in such conditions.
translation: 那可能给工人造成危险的工作环境，而且在这种条件下施工所需的设备也会增加成本。

source: But don’t worry – the originally scheduled downtime has already been considered and it shouldn’t affect our targeted completion date.
translation: 不过别担心——原定停工期已经纳入考虑，不会影响目标完工日期。

source: In fact, I’ve already consulted with Mr. Clermont and he has given his approval for the break.
translation: 事实上，我已经咨询过Clermont先生，他也批准了这段休息期。

source: It was in the e-mail chain you requested access to. Did you get a chance to read it?
translation: 那就在你申请访问的邮件对话中。你有机会读过吗？

source: O-Of course I have! It’s my job to know all the details of the project after all!
translation: 当、当然读过！毕竟了解项目所有细节是我的职责！

source: I only adjusted the schedule based on the issues that were made apparent to me yesterday during my survey!
translation: 我只是根据昨天调查中发现的问题调整了日程！

source: It’s common sense to ensure that there is plenty of time at the tail-end of any project to allow for any setbacks, which was my main reason for the extended work period!
translation: 在任何项目末期预留充足时间应对挫折都是常识，这正是我延长工作期的主要原因！

source: But if you want to do it your way, then so be it.
translation: 不过既然你想按自己的方式来，那就这样吧。

source: Just be prepared for stricter deadlines and less room for error!
translation: 只要做好面对更严格期限和更小容错空间的准备！

source: Is that all? We’re wasting that ‘precious work time’ right now with this meeting.
translation: 就这些吗？我们现在正用这场会议浪费那“宝贵的工作时间”。

source: Excuse me?!
translation: 你说什么？！

source: Maybe we can move forward and discuss the specifics of the schedule?
translation: 也许我们可以继续，讨论日程的具体内容？

source: I would have if I wasn’t so rudely interrupted.
translation: 要不是被如此无礼地打断，我本来已经在说了。

source: Anyway, I am left with no choice but to cede to the camp president’s decision, and will include this extensive break in our schedule.
translation: 总之，我只能服从营地负责人的决定，把这段漫长休息期纳入日程。

source: That means we need to get as much work done as possible before the season ends.
translation: 这意味着我们必须在季节结束前尽可能多地完成工作。

source: Everyone should follow the instructions I’ve handed out today, but I will follow up with a revised schedule with STRICTER deadlines, as Mr. Nomoru requested.
translation: 所有人都应遵循我今天发放的说明，不过应Nomoru先生要求，我之后会提供一份期限更严格的修订日程。

source: I’ll be checking on all of your progress at the end of the day. You’re all dismissed!
translation: 今天结束时我会检查所有人的进度。各位解散！

source: Yoshinori.
translation: Yoshinori。

source: Yes, Emilia?
translation: 怎么了，Emilia？

source: Come with me for a moment. I’d like to talk about something.
translation: 跟我来一下。我想谈件事。

source: Oh… Alright, then.
translation: 哦……那好吧。

source: Lovely weather we’re having today, aren’t we?
translation: 今天天气真不错，对吧？

source: Y-Yeah.
translation: 是、是啊。

source: Can you believe we have found ourselves again at the same place?
translation: 你能相信我们又在同一个地方相遇了吗？

source: If you had told the me from almost ten years ago, I wouldn’t have believed it.
translation: 如果告诉近十年前的我，我绝不会相信。

source: But I do have to say, it is somewhat comforting that this place is the same as it used to be, as unfortunate as that sounds.
translation: 不过我得说，这里仍和从前一样，多少让人感到安心，虽然这话听起来有些遗憾。

source: I’d always come to this spot so no one could find me, and I wouldn’t have to deal with other people.
translation: 过去我总会来这里，让任何人都找不到，也不必应付别人。

source: Every day I spent here was miserable. Everyone hated me for just saying things as they were.
translation: 在这里度过的每一天都很痛苦。只因我实话实说，所有人都讨厌我。

source: I know everyone was just jealous of my higher status, so the only thing they could do was to cast me out.
translation: 我知道大家只是嫉妒我更高的地位，所以只能排斥我。

source: I’m sorry, but… Is… this what you really wanted to talk about…?
translation: 抱歉，不过……这……真的是你想谈的事吗……？

source: Goodness gracious, I was getting there… Am I not allowed to set the mood?
translation: 我的天，我正要说到重点……难道不允许我先营造气氛吗？

source: Hmph! Since when did you become such a buzzkill?
translation: 哼！你什么时候变得这么扫兴了？

source: Well, I figured that since we’re going to work so closely for the next couple of months, it would be nice to start fresh and catch up, on a more personal level~!
translation: 我想，既然未来几个月我们会紧密合作，不妨重新开始，在更私人的层面上叙叙旧～！

source: This is a huge project after all, you’re going to need my help!
translation: 毕竟这是个庞大的项目，你会需要我的帮助！

source: Think of it as me returning the favor. I don’t want to let an old friend down, after all.
translation: 就当是我回报你。毕竟我不想让老朋友失望。

source: Ah, about that, Emilia…
translation: 啊，说到这个，Emilia……

source: I thought it would be best if I concentrate my efforts on the construction and staff management departments.
translation: 我认为自己最好把精力集中在施工和员工管理部门。

source: Since those do have the most room for improvement, as you said back in the meeting. Aiden could really use some help with the oversight.
translation: 就像你在会议上说的，那些部门确实最有改进空间。Aiden也很需要有人协助监督。

source: What…? Aiden?
translation: 什么……？Aiden？

source: You mean the helper?
translation: 你是说那个帮工？

source: So, you’re telling me your plan is to help wash dishes and unclog toilets to contribute to this project? My ears must be broken.
translation: 所以你告诉我，你对项目的贡献计划就是帮忙洗盘子、疏通厕所？我的耳朵一定坏了。

source: W-What…?
translation: 什、什么……？

source: Why in the world would you demote yourself to such grueling labor?!
translation: 你为什么要自降身份去做那种苦力？！

source: You could be working in a position of leadership and instead you choose manual labor? You must not be the same person I remember!
translation: 你明明可以担任领导职务，却选择体力劳动？你一定不是我记忆中的那个人！

source: Emilia! That’s not—
translation: Emilia！不是那样——

source: So be it, Yoshinori. Don’t come crying to me when you are fully aware of how excruciatingly hectic the next few months are going to be!
translation: 那就这样吧，Yoshinori。你明知未来几个月会忙得多么痛苦，到时可别哭着来找我！

source: Oh! He’s back, you guys!
translation: 哦！他回来了，各位！

source: Over here, Yoshi!
translation: 这边，Yoshi！

source: Ah, looks like you guys are done with breakfast.
translation: 啊，看来你们已经吃完早餐了。

source: Ahehe… Yeah… Your food’s gotten cold already.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……是啊……你的食物已经凉了。

source: We were gonna wait for you, but everyone’s kinda in a hurry.
translation: 我们本来想等你，但大家都有点赶时间。

source: I figured we should show up for work early now that we have an inspector.
translation: 既然现在有检查员，我想我们应该早点到岗。

source: What did Emilia even drag you away for?
translation: Emilia把你拉走到底是为了什么？

source: Hmph. Probably to talk shit about all of us.
translation: 哼。大概是为了说我们所有人的坏话。

source: No, Yuri, it was nothing like that...
translation: 不，Yuri，完全不是那样……

source: She was asking if I planned to accept her offer about working with her for the rest of the project.
translation: 她问我是否打算接受提议，在项目剩余时间里与她合作。

source: Huh??? For what?
translation: 啊？？？为了什么？

source: Ms. Emilia seems to be partial towards Yoshi, from observation.
translation: 据我观察，Emilia女士似乎格外偏爱Yoshi。

source: Seriously, I think it’s just some excuse to get Yoshi to do her job or something.
translation: 说真的，我觉得那只是让Yoshi替她干活之类的借口。

source: Did you take her up on the offer?
translation: 你接受她的提议了吗？

source: No, actually. I’ve already decided to focus on working with Aiden.
translation: 没有。其实我已经决定专心和Aiden一起工作。

source: How’d she take that?
translation: 她怎么反应？

source: W-Well, let’s just say she was really expecting I’d say yes to her offer…
translation: 这、这个，只能说她真的很期待我会答应……

source: Sheesh… I can only imagine her reaction.
translation: 天啊……我只能想象她的反应。

source: She didn't seem to take it well when I spoke up at the meeting earlier.
translation: 刚才我在会议上提出异议时，她好像也没有很好地接受。

source: Yeah… I can tell that lady does not like us at all.
translation: 是啊……看得出来那位女士一点也不喜欢我们。

source: Her tone was very... pointy.
translation: 她的语气非常……尖锐。

source: Oh, thank goodness, it’s not just me!
translation: 哦，谢天谢地，原来不只是我！

source: Why did you even let her take charge, Dad? You've been in charge of everything this whole time just fine.
translation: 爸爸，你为什么让她掌权？一直以来由你负责一切都很好。

source: I… didn’t expect that she would be going this far to be honest. I wasn’t informed that our inspector would also be getting involved in management…
translation: 老实说，我……没想到她会做到这种程度。没人告诉我检查员还会介入管理……

source: She didn’t even DO anything! All she did was make a crappy schedule and then agree to go back to the one you made, Dad.
translation: 她根本什么都没做！只是制定了一份糟糕的日程，然后又同意改回你制定的那份，爸爸。

source: Hmm… Perhaps Mr. Clermont directly ordered her to make those changes…
translation: 嗯……也许是Clermont先生直接命令她作出那些改变……

source: I doubt it. Like you said back there, he already knew about the winter break. She’s just trying to nitpick and micromanage like she did yesterday!
translation: 我不相信。就像你刚才说的，他早就知道冬季休息期。她只是在像昨天一样吹毛求疵、事事插手！

source: Yeah… I don't understand why she labeled the construction department as ‘DELAYED’ in red ink and all caps. As far as I know we were doing just fine…
translation: 是啊……我不明白她为什么用红色全大写把施工部门标成“延误”。据我所知，我们进展得很好……

source: She said the same thing to me yesterday, too… It’s why I was up working all night…
translation: 她昨天也对我说了同样的话……所以我才通宵工作……

source: It’s only her first day here and she’s already crossing the line!
translation: 她才来第一天就已经越界了！

source: Calm down, Yuri… I don’t think we have to take everything she said so personally.
translation: 冷静点，Yuri……我觉得没必要把她说的每句话都当成针对个人。

source: We don’t need to like her, but Mr. Clermont assigned her here for a reason. We have to trust his judgement.
translation: 我们不必喜欢她，但Clermont先生安排她来这里必有原因。我们必须相信他的判断。

source: Let’s give her the benefit of the doubt for now. We know at the very least that we all have the same common goal.
translation: 现在先姑且相信她吧。至少我们知道，大家拥有同一个共同目标。

source: I don’t know about you guys, but I have a really bad gut feeling about that Emilia.
translation: 不知道你们怎么想，但我对那个Emilia有种非常不好的直觉。

source: I understand your concerns, Yuri. But we have to work together for now and stay professional, especially since she was sent directly by our sponsor.
translation: 我理解你的担忧，Yuri。但现在我们必须合作并保持专业，尤其她是赞助方直接派来的。

source: Ugh… Fine. I’ll try to not to stoop down to her level, and I’ll prove we can do our job.
translation: 呃……好吧。我会尽量不降到她的层次，并证明我们能做好工作。

source: Come with me to the office and let’s calm your nerves a bit with some tea.
translation: 跟我去办公室，喝点茶平复一下情绪。

source: *sigh* Okay, dad.
translation: *叹气* 好吧，爸爸。

source: I guess Dar and I better get to work too. Don’t wanna get marked as delayed again, right?
translation: 看来我和Dar也最好去工作。不想再次被标成延误，对吧？

source: Bye.
translation: 再见。

source: I guess I’ll go ahead as well… With all these new deadlines, I might need to get some more work done before bed…
translation: 我想我也先走了……有了这些新期限，睡觉前可能还得多做些工作……

source: Things are really starting to change around here, huh Yoshi?
translation: 这里真的开始发生变化了，对吧，Yoshi？

source: Haha, yeah…
translation: 哈哈，是啊……

source: Are you sure you’re really alright with working with me? It must’ve been awkward having that talk with Emilia.
translation: 你确定真的愿意和我一起工作吗？与Emilia进行那场谈话一定很尴尬。

source: Don’t worry about it, Aiden. Like I said yesterday, I’m really looking forward to working with you for the rest of the project.
translation: 别担心，Aiden。就像我昨天说的，我真的很期待在项目剩余时间里与你合作。

source: Are you worried about all the assignments you’ve been given?
translation: 你在担心分配给自己的所有任务吗？

source: Ahehe… You knew exactly what I’m thinking, huh?
translation: 啊嘿嘿……你完全知道我在想什么，对吧？

source: But yeah, I kinda took a peek inside those stacks of papers while you were gone, and she’s added a bunch of extra maintenance tasks on top of all my other work…
translation: 不过是的，你离开时我稍微翻了翻那叠文件，她在我其他工作上又增加了一大堆额外维护任务……

source: She wants me to clean up after the construction workers at the site every day, and write these super detailed reports that I don’t even know how to do…
translation: 她要我每天清理工人在施工现场留下的东西，还要写这些详细得过头、我根本不会写的报告……

source: It’s just… a lot of expectations for someone like me.
translation: 只是……对我这样的人而言，期望实在太高了。

source: It’s just… a lot of expectations for someone like me.{fast}
translation: 只是……对我这样的人而言，期望实在太高了。{fast}

source: Don't doubt yourself.
translation: 不要怀疑自己。

source: Don’t doubt yourself, Aiden.
translation: 不要怀疑自己，Aiden。

source: We rely on you a lot more than you think!
translation: 我们对你的依赖远比你以为的更多！

source: W-Well, that’s kinda what I’m afraid of.
translation: 这、这个，这正是我有点害怕的地方。

source: I’m so used to doing simple chores, and I really have no idea how to do the ‘management’ stuff.
translation: 我太习惯做简单杂务了，真的完全不知道该怎么做那些“管理”工作。

source: Don’t worry, Aiden! I’ll lead the way, and you follow!
translation: 别担心，Aiden！我来带路，你跟着我！

source: I’ll try my best then! I’m counting on you, Yoshi…!
translation: 那我会尽力！靠你了，Yoshi……！

source: I'll cover for you.
translation: 我会替你兜底。

source: I’ll cover for you, Aiden!
translation: 我会替你兜底，Aiden！

source: That’s kinda what I feel guilty about…
translation: 这正是让我有些内疚的地方……

source: I know you can do it.
translation: 我知道你能做到。

source: I know you can do it, Aiden!
translation: 我知道你能做到，Aiden！

source: Especially since we’re gonna have each other backs!
translation: 尤其我们还会互相支持！

source: Besides, I’m a lot more used to doing simple chores, so I’m really glad you got the ‘management’ stuff covered!
translation: 而且我更习惯做简单杂务，所以真高兴有你负责那些“管理”工作！

source: Yeah! You can count on me, Aiden!
translation: 是啊！你可以依靠我，Aiden！

source: You lead the way and I’ll follow!
translation: 你来带路，我会跟上！

source: That's what I'm here for.
translation: 这正是我来这里的目的。

source: That’s what I’m here for, Aiden!
translation: 这正是我来这里的目的，Aiden！

source: If I’m always around, I’m sure we can work things out!
translation: 只要我一直在身边，相信我们能解决一切！

source: For the next few weeks, Aiden and I worked side by side on our tasks.
translation: 接下来的几周里，我和Aiden并肩完成各项任务。

source: I had been assigned to manage the construction team, while Aiden handled staff welfare and overall camp maintenance.
translation: 我被安排管理施工团队，Aiden则负责员工福祉和营地整体维护。

source: With Emilia pushing a tight schedule, the construction moved forward at a very fast pace.
translation: 在Emilia紧迫日程的推动下，施工进展非常迅速。

source: Aiden and I didn’t hesitate to get our hands dirty, and we both learned a bunch of new things about construction from Darius and Lloyd.
translation: 我和Aiden毫不犹豫地亲自动手，也从Darius和Lloyd那里学到了许多施工知识。

source: Everyone worked extra hard to meet the deadlines and we managed to accomplish every target Emilia set for us.
translation: 每个人都格外努力地赶期限，我们成功完成了Emilia设定的每个目标。

source: Seeing the frameworks of the new cabins at the expansion site, we could already imagine how different the camp was going to look.
translation: 看到扩建场地中新小屋的框架，我们已经能想象营地未来会变得多么不同。

source: While we were busy with our tasks, Jin spent many sleepless nights working on the technological goals of the project.
translation: 我们忙于任务时，Jin 度过许多个不眠之夜，推进项目的技术目标。

source: He relaunched our website, and included online enrollments and job applications.
translation: 他重新上线了网站，并加入在线报名和求职申请功能。

source: From what he explained, he also secured an internet connection and a security system for the camp.
translation: 据他解释，还为营地落实了网络连接和安防系统。

source: Meanwhile, Sir Goro was swamped with legal work regarding the sponsorship, as usual.
translation: 与此同时，Goro先生一如既往地被赞助相关法律工作淹没。

source: Between that and processing all the new applications from the brand-new website, there was more work than ever.
translation: 再加上处理新网站收到的所有申请，工作比以往任何时候都多。

source: Thankfully, because Aiden and I were handling the construction team, Yuri was able to focus on assisting Sir Goro.
translation: 幸好我和Aiden负责施工团队，Yuri得以专心协助Goro先生。

source: Together they managed the project’s documentation, and each report sent to Emilia validated each department’s progress.
translation: 他们共同管理项目文件，每份发送给Emilia的报告都证明了各部门的进展。

source: On top of our other responsibilities, Aiden and I made sure that the camp was well-maintained and that the staff was properly cared for.
translation: 除其他职责外，我和Aiden还确保营地维护良好，员工得到妥善照顾。

source: Almost all of our time was spent working, but I made sure to take advantage of our shared tasks and spend plenty of quality time with him.
translation: 我们几乎把所有时间都花在工作上，但我会利用共同任务的机会，与他度过许多珍贵时光。

source: We received many critiques from Emilia’s inspections, and she grew more and more frustrated.
translation: Emilia在检查中提出了许多批评，而且她变得越来越沮丧。

source: I could see Aiden beginning to rethink his role at the camp from all the criticisms, and all I could do was try to have his back and reassure him.
translation: 我看得出，这些批评让Aiden开始重新思考自己在营地的角色，而我能做的只有支持并安慰他。

source: As much as the work was physically exhausting, he kept smiling through everything, and it really encouraged me to keep doing my best.
translation: 尽管工作让身体筋疲力尽，他始终微笑面对一切，这真的鼓励我继续竭尽全力。

source: Seeing Aiden happy with my company made it all worth it.
translation: 看到Aiden因我的陪伴而开心，一切都值得了。

source: {i}Before we knew it, a month and a half had gone by, and the season was about to change again…{/i}
translation: {i}不知不觉，一个半月过去了，季节即将再次更替……{/i}
